in_marathi.name: Eshaan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eshaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eshaan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ishaan', which means 'Lord Shiva'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is a tribute to the supreme deity, Lord Shiva. Eshaan is believed to bring good luck, prosperity, and strength to the one who bears this name.
